acceptance: The contract places Code inside the existing Knowledge workspace and Lens shell; no new top-level application, duplicate navigation or CBM iframe is permitted.
Symbol Graph, Import Graph and Call Graph plus Overview, Impact, Dependencies, Timeline, Trace and Code Planet are named without collapsing topology, semantic proximity or runtime trace truth.
Every visible mode names its source, version or generation, locator, confidence and clipping or freshness semantics.
Desktop, mobile, keyboard, reduced-motion, loading, empty, error, disabled, stale, partial and clipped states are explicit and testable.
The contract consumes only bounded CBM-08 projection capabilities; it cannot control the engine, index a repository, expose raw IDs or request an unbounded graph.
No renderer, route, productive graph, source access, provider, network, stage, commit, push, deploy or live action is added by the product writer.
forbidden: a third writer path, roadmap edit, UI implementation, renderer, route or source edit
a new top-level application, duplicate navigation shell or embedded CBM iframe
unbounded graph payloads, raw engine control, repository indexing or raw internal identifiers
topology, semantic proximity and runtime trace presented as interchangeable truth
stage, commit, push, deploy, provider, network, host, private-data or live action by the product writer
hostile_matrix: Symbol, import and call views remain distinct from semantic Code Planet proximity and from runtime Trace evidence.
Each visible graph state binds source authority, version or generation, locator, confidence and stale, partial or clipped semantics.
Loading, empty, error, disabled, stale, partial and clipped states remain distinguishable and do not overclaim completeness.
Keyboard, mobile and reduced-motion behavior retains equivalent navigation and truth disclosure.
The contract never grants engine control, indexing, unbounded expansion, raw identifier exposure or live authority.
threat_model: A Code Graph specification can accidentally create a second application, collapse static topology, semantic proximity and runtime traces into one false truth, hide stale or clipped data, omit accessible states, or imply unbounded CBM engine control. LCG-00 closes only the product truth and navigation contract inside the accepted Knowledge/Lens shell and leaves all renderer, route, source and live work outside this claim.

verification_tiers.dependency: LCG-00 contract plus accepted CBM-08 graph projection suite
verification_tiers.central: Integration Spine, Round6 and Guidance validators
verification_tiers.sol_review: fresh independent Sol semantic review on frozen candidate

stop_rule: Stop before registration or writer dispatch on authority, architecture, baseline, path, overlap, command, named-node, claim or lease drift. Stop implementation on a third writer path, source-before-valid-RED, roadmap or UI edit, duplicate shell, truth-boundary collapse, unbounded payload, raw engine control or any external action. After one same-class correction, release blocked and require fresh Root/Sol architecture.
